Tap in for the conversation on @netflix

🚨 Mayor rasjbaraka breaks down his lawsuit against the federal government following his arrest and explains his role in protecting the citizens of Newark. 🏙️⚖️ Tap in for the full conversation as he speaks on accountability, leadership, and standing up for his community on @netflix

🚨 Dr. Cheyenne Bryant makes it clear: she doesn’t tell people what to do in their marriages. Instead, she teaches people how not to emotionally bleed on their partner and how to work on themselves individually. “No one can teach people how to be married, we teach people how to get out of their own way.” Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

🚨 @_drbryant gets candid about why she believes her work is scrutinized so heavily 👀 She breaks down the concept of “Pretty Punishment” and how appearance can sometimes impact the way women are perceived, criticized, and received in professional spaces. 🎙️✨

Video

🚨 Newark Mayor @rasjbaraka breaks down how he believes the Trump administration has negatively impacted the financial future of everyday Americans and explains why he continues fighting for the people of Newark every single day. 🏙️💼 Tap in for the full conversation on @netflix  before you hit the polls Newark!

Video

🚨Sheryl Underwood speaks out about the “inappropriate jokes” made during the Kevin Hart Roast and makes it clear that roast jokes aren’t meant for mainstream consumption. “Sometimes political correctness doesn’t fit in comedy.” Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa !

Video

Yesterday, Kendrick Lamar’s 'GNX' album disappeared from Apple Music and Tidal, and the music video was taken down on YouTube! This all happened the same week Drake is slated to release *Ice Man* 👀 But what really happened? Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video
After Kevin Hart’s roast, some of the jokes had viewers up in arms! Is there such a thing as going too far when it comes to jokes, especially at a roast? Let's discuss ⬇️ call in 800-585-1051
